name: Darkspear Islands Clash
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
